profile.name: Matin Zarifamin
profile.tagline: I build interfaces that feel instant.
profile.summary: Senior frontend engineer with 6+ years crafting AI-driven products, real-time dashboards and design systems. At Hiweb / Selfit I own frontend architecture across seven products shipping to 900K+ users, and mentor the three engineers who build them — obsessed with Core Web Vitals and interfaces that feel alive.

terminal.hint: This terminal is real — click it and type `help`.

points: Own frontend architecture across seven SaaS, PWA and AI products.
Built the design system: 60+ components with visual regression in CI.
Replaced WebSocket with SSE streaming for the AI chatbot — TTFT −67%.
Mentor three frontend engineers on review, performance and release standards.
Work AI-assisted daily — Claude Code for spec-driven refactors and codemods.
Built real-time analytics dashboards in React & TypeScript.
Interactive time-series charts with server pagination and virtualization.
~95% on-time delivery, turning ambiguous specs into shipped features.

projects.dockHint: Click an app to read the story

hiweb-ai.name: Hiweb AI Chatbot
hiweb-ai.tagline: 24/7 ISP smart support with live token streaming
hiweb-ai.description: An AI support assistant for one of Iran's largest ISPs. I designed the streaming architecture end-to-end — replacing WebSocket with fetch/SSE streaming for real-time tokens from the LLM backend.
highlights: p50 time-to-first-token 1.2s → 0.4s (−67%)
Chat completion rate +18%, lead→sale +6.5% on high-intent flows
Serving ~600K Hiweb users in production

selfit-coach.name: Selfit AI Coach
selfit-coach.tagline: An embeddable fitness assistant that personalizes daily plans
selfit-coach.description: A framework-agnostic Web Component chatbot embedded across Selfit products. One build, every app — with standardized UI/UX and analytics baked in.
highlights: Removed duplicate per-app builds — ~65% less engineering effort
Integration time cut ~70%: days → hours
Personalized daily workout & nutrition plans via LLM workflows

selfit-app.name: Selfit Web App
selfit-app.description: The employee-facing PWA for Iran's leading corporate-welfare platform: booking sports venues, wallets, entitlements and more — installable, offline-friendly and fast on low-end devices.
highlights: ~300K active users with p75 Web Vitals kept healthy under peak load
RUM + Sentry observability with feature-flagged rollouts
Lighthouse 90+ on key journeys

selfit-landing.name: Selfit Corporate Site
selfit-landing.tagline: The public site that sells Selfit to HR and welfare teams
selfit-landing.description: Selfit's marketing site: the first thing an HR lead sees before any demo. Statically generated and bilingual, with the service catalogue, pricing story and lead capture all prerendered for search.
highlights: Fully prerendered — every marketing page ships as static HTML
Bilingual, RTL-correct, sharing the product design system
Service catalogue and lead forms feed the same B2B pipeline

selfit-b2b.name: Selfit B2B Admin
selfit-b2b.tagline: HR enrollment, budgets and analytics for organizations
selfit-b2b.description: The admin panel HR teams use to manage enrollment, entitlements and budgets — heavy tables, exports and analytics dashboards built for daily operational work.
highlights: Virtualized data grids with server pagination for large orgs
Interactive analytics: time-series charts, funnels and exports
Role-based access control across organization hierarchies

selfit-provider.name: Selfit Provider Panel
selfit-provider.tagline: Self-service console for the gyms, pools and clinics on Selfit
selfit-provider.description: The panel every partner venue uses to manage its branches, services, pricing and redemptions. OTP-only sign-in, role-scoped data, and a scan-to-redeem flow that has to work on a phone at a busy reception desk.
highlights: Venue onboarding moved from a support ticket to a self-serve form
Scan-to-redeem settles a booking in seconds at the desk
Shares a component library with the B2B panel — one design system, two products

seltrip.name: SELTrip
seltrip.tagline: Large-result travel search on the Next.js App Router
seltrip.description: Led the strategic migration from a legacy SPA to the Next.js App Router with RSC, SSR/ISR and edge caching — a travel search engine with huge result sets and low-latency filtering.
highlights: LCP p75 1.6s vs 4.8s on the legacy SPA (−67%)
INP 120ms vs 320ms (−63%), CLS 0.04 vs 0.18
SEO uplift via server metadata, sitemaps and on-demand ISR

parsonline-ai.name: ParsOnline AI Assistant
parsonline-ai.tagline: The streaming chat stack from Hiweb, generalized for a second ISP
parsonline-ai.description: ParsOnline's customer-facing AI assistant. The streaming core proven at Hiweb became a reusable chat runtime: branding, knowledge base and intents are per-tenant configuration on top of a single codebase.
highlights: A second ISP went live on the same runtime — configuration, not a rebuild
Token streaming over fetch/SSE, with sessions that survive a dropped connection
Answers grounded in each operator's own support corpus

esim.name: eSIM Commerce
esim.tagline: Buy and manage travel eSIMs — app and web
esim.description: End-to-end eSIM purchase and management flows for travelers: plan discovery, checkout, QR provisioning and usage tracking across web and app.
highlights: Multi-step checkout tuned for conversion
Instant QR provisioning flow with live activation status
Shared design-system primitives across app and site

rose-menu.name: Rose Café Menu
rose-menu.tagline: A freelance digital menu: motion-led storefront plus its own admin
rose-menu.description: A QR menu for a café — an animated, image-first storefront for guests and a full admin panel for categories, items, pricing and availability. Built phone-first, because nearly every visit is a phone at a table.
highlights: Guest view is phone-first: large imagery, no zooming, no app to install
Admin panel for categories, items, pricing and availability
Framer Motion throughout, kept inside a tight mobile performance budget

almas-dental.name: Almas Dental Clinic
almas-dental.tagline: Freelance clinic site built around the question patients actually search
almas-dental.description: A marketing site for a Tehran dental clinic, built around one question patients actually type: which supplementary insurance does this clinic accept. Statically generated, Persian-first, with structured data for local search.
highlights: Statically generated — the whole site ships as prerendered HTML
Insurance coverage, services and FAQ modelled as structured data
Call and WhatsApp consultation paths above the fold

farda-insurance.name: Farda Insurance
farda-insurance.tagline: Policy purchase & management, from quote to bind
farda-insurance.description: A digital insurance platform covering the full journey — quoting, binding, payments and a policy-management dashboard.
highlights: Quote → bind flow with resumable multi-step forms
Policy dashboard with payments and renewals
Accessible form UX with robust validation

prodoc.name: ProDoc
prodoc.tagline: Lightweight Next.js landing for a healthcare-AI product
prodoc.description: A fast, SEO-first marketing site for a healthcare/AI product — static-generated, minimal JS, maximal polish.
highlights: Static generation with near-perfect Lighthouse scores
Motion design that stays out of the content's way
Shipped end-to-end in a tight timeline
